exposure_rule: Previously exposed July 7-11 are training only. Freeze the protocol before July 14-18 outcomes. No refitting, threshold tuning, epoch search or model selection on validation/test.
sampling: First completed target event at least 1 second after prior decision, including zero OFI, flat queue and disagreeing signals
causal_eligibility: One tick spread, five seconds feature warmup since startup or inactivity reset, decision plus 17 seconds strictly before 16:00; no CVD, OFI or queue sign filter
targets: For every eligible decision, price both long and short from the same later entry/exit quotes, crossing spread and subtracting one extra tick. No-trade hindsight label only if both observed net returns are nonpositive. Unavailable entries and unresolved exits have unknown labels, never fabricated no-trade labels.
late_and_inactivity_outcomes: Keep observed outcomes with explicit late/inactivity flags in training and evaluation. Do not remove losing gaps. Unresolved targets are retained but excluded from regression; selected unresolved exposure blocks a positive policy conclusion.
model: Two-output float64 ridge regression of long/short net ticks; train-only population mean and scale, clip standardized features to +/-10; intercept unpenalized; mean squared error plus lambda=1 times squared weights; one closed-form solve
policy: Choose the larger predicted net return only if strictly above 0.5 ticks, otherwise no trade; no trade on a tie. One position at a time, ten-second cooldown after observed exit or rejected/expired entry. Future targets never determine selection eligibility or direction.
evaluation: Report regression error and hindsight-label counts separately from sequential nonoverlapping policy results; evaluate validation and test once with the identical frozen model; report all no-entry, unresolved and inactivity exposure
positive_gate: Require at least 100 closed test trades total, at least 20 per test day, positive mean net pooled and every test day, no unresolved or inactivity-exposed selected test trades; even then independent replication and broker validation are required
quality_rule: Abort full cohort on source hash, metadata, mapping, book, timestamp, incomplete event or minimum label count failure; no successful-subset training or automatic protocol relaxation
